test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: L, M, N, O, P, Q and R, are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only three people sit between Q and N. M and O are immediate neighbours O is at the extreme right end of the row. R is at the immediate left of N. Who is at the fifth position from the left end of the row?
solution: Given: L, M, N, O, P, Q and R, are sitting in a straight row, facing north. 1) Only three people sit between Q and N. 2) M and O are immediate neighbors. 3) O is at the extreme right end of the row.
